description: This file defines the Event class within the Opencart system, responsible for initializing and registering system and catalog events during the startup process.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Handles event registration during the startup phase, fetching event configurations from the database and registering appropriate triggers.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes event handling by loading event data from the database and registering event triggers based on their type (catalog or system).
